(def compare-and-set!
  "Atomically sets the value of atom to newval if and only if the
  current value of the atom is identical to oldval. Returns true if
  set happened, else false."
  (fn [a oldval newval]
    (if (instance? Atom a)
      (let [validate (.-validator a)]
        (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? validate)
          (when-not (validate newval)
            (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Invalid reference state"))))
        (if (atom-unchanged? (.-state a) oldval)
          (do (set! (.-state a) newval)
              (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? (.-watches a))
                (-notify-watches a oldval newval))
              true)
          false))
      (if (= (-deref a) oldval)
        (do (-reset! a newval) true)
        false))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation. Follows Clojure's Atom.compareAndSet: validates newval first, compares the current state with oldval as atom-unchanged? does (identical?, as AtomicReference compares references; ClojureScript uses =), and notifies watches only when it sets. Non-Atom references keep the upstream IDeref/= /IReset fallback.
